definitions.explanation: The collapse or sliding of earth and rock from a steep slope or cliff, often caused by heavy rain or earthquakes.

examples.japanese: ⟦{大雨|おおあめ}→大雨：03015_ooame⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{崖崩|がけくず}れ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{起|お}きた→起きる：00521_okiru⟧。
examples.english: A landslide occurred due to heavy rain.

examples.japanese: {崖崩|がけくず}れ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{危険|きけん}→危険：01141_kiken⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧、⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{道路|どうろ}→道路：01481_douro⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{通行止|つうこうど}め→通行止め：19920_tsuukoudome⟧です。
examples.english: This road is closed due to the risk of landslide.

examples.japanese: ⟦{台風|たいふう}→台風：01455_taifuu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{影響|えいきょう}→影響：01877_eikyou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{各地|かくち}→各地：00155_kakuchi⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{崖崩|がけくず}れ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{発生|はっせい}→発生：03133_hassei⟧し、⟦{住宅|じゅうたく}→住宅：03280_juutaku⟧や⟦{道路|どうろ}→道路：01481_douro⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{大|おお}きな→大きな：02849_ookina⟧⟦{被害|ひがい}→被害：02572_higai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出|で}た→出る：00513_deru⟧。
examples.english: Landslides occurred in various areas due to the typhoon, causing major damage to homes and roads.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{崖|がけ}→崖：05391_gake⟧ (cliff, bluff) + {崩|くず}れ (collapse, crumbling). A common hazard in Japan during the rainy season and typhoon season. Frequently appears in weather warnings and disaster news.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {崖崩|がけくず}れ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{起|お}きる→起きる：00521_okiru⟧: a landslide occurs
- {崖崩|がけくず}れ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{発生|はっせい}する→発生する：25529_hasseisuru⟧: a landslide occurs (formal)
- {崖崩|がけくず}れ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{危険|きけん}→危険：01141_kiken⟧: risk of landslide
- {崖崩|がけくず}れ⟦{注意|ちゅうい}→注意：01464_chuui⟧: landslide warning
- {崖崩|がけくず}れ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{巻|ま}き{込|こ}まれる→巻き込む：05753_makikomu⟧: to be caught in a landslide

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{土砂崩|どしゃくず}れ→土砂崩れ：09257_doshakuzure⟧: earth and sand slide — similar but emphasizes mud and debris
- ⟦{地滑|じすべ}り→地滑り：21160_jisuberi⟧: landslide — a broader, slower sliding of ground
- {山崩|やまくず}れ: mountain collapse — larger-scale collapse of a mountainside
- {土石流|どせきりゅう}: mudflow, debris flow — fast-moving flow of mud and rocks
